title: A Modular Framework for Automated Segmentation and Analysis of AFM Imaging of Chromatin Organization
authors: Sørensen EW; Pangeni S; Urteaga-Merino R; Murray PJ; Rudnizky S; Liao T; Rashid F; Hwang J; Yamadi M; Feng XA; Zähringer J; Gu S; Davidson IF; Caccianini L; Osorio-Valeriano M; Farnung L; Vos SM; Peters J; Berger J; Wu C; Hatzakis NS; Kirkegaard JB; Ha T
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了基于机器学习的AFM图像自动分割框架DNAsight，用于量化染色质DNA空间组织、环化和蛋白聚集，虽非TF-DNA结合建模，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作的结构分析且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Chromatin organization underlies essential genome functions, but its nanoscale organization remains challenging to capture and quantify with precision. Atomic force microscopy (AFM) offers direct structural readouts of DNA and chromatin, yet translating these rich images into reproducible biological metrics has been limited by the lack of standardized, scalable analysis tools. Here we present DNAsight, an automated analysis framework that integrates machine learning (ML)-based segmentation with modular, base-pair-calibrated quantification of DNA spatial organization, looping, nucleosome spacing, and protein clustering. Applied across diverse chromatin-associated proteins, DNAsight reveals protein-specific organizational signatures, including topology-dependent compaction by integration host factor (IHF), condition-dependent changes in loop-like DNA structures in cohesin-CTCF-precocious dissociation of sisters 5A (PDS5A) reactions, and promoter-driven multimerization of GAGA factor (GAF) clusters. The framework further enables direct extraction of nucleosome spacing distributions from raw AFM images, providing a label-free route to investigate chromatin fiber architecture. Together, these advances establish DNAsight as a generalizable and scalable approach for converting AFM measurements into quantitative insights into the physical principles of chromatin organization.

abstract_zh:
摘要

染色质组织是基因组基本功能的基础，但其纳米尺度组织仍难以精确捕获和量化。原子力显微镜（AFM）可直接提供DNA和染色质的结构读数，然而将这些丰富图像转化为可重复的生物学指标一直受限于缺乏标准化、可扩展的分析工具。在此，我们提出DNAsight，一种自动化分析框架，它整合了基于机器学习（ML）的分割与模块化、碱基对校准的DNA空间组织、成环、核小体间距及蛋白质聚集定量分析。应用于多种染色质相关蛋白时，DNAsight揭示了蛋白质特异性的组织特征，包括由整合宿主因子（IHF）引起的拓扑依赖性压缩、cohesin-CTCF-姐妹染色单体早分离蛋白5A（PDS5A）反应中环状DNA结构的条件依赖性变化，以及启动子驱动的GAGA因子（GAF）簇多聚化。该框架还支持从原始AFM图像中直接提取核小体间距分布，为研究染色质纤维结构提供了一条无标记途径。综合这些进展，DNAsight确立为一种通用且可扩展的方法，可将AFM测量转化为对染色质组织物理原理的定量见解。
